verdict.rationale: Twilio Video's marketing page claims built-in real-time transcription of in-session speech, so live session audio is processed by a transcription service while the session runs. There is no documented way to stream raw session audio to a user-chosen external transcription or realtime model endpoint. Missing for 10: documented audio streaming/forking to custom external endpoints, realtime AI model integration, API docs detailing the transcription pipeline, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, live session audio can be streamed to a transcription or realtime model endpoint while the session is running

citations.quote: Transcribe speech to on-screen text in real-time across languages, with HIPAA support for healthcare.
